concerns.label: Public awareness and trust
concerns.scope: Informed public understanding or institutional trust.
concerns.inclusion: Explicit informedness, public communication or trust in institutions.
concerns.exclusion: Route approval, medical support or specific camera discomfort alone.
concerns.illustrative_anchors: Refusal of institutional involvement=1; openness pending transparency=4; informed institutional support=8.

concerns.label: Competence building
concerns.scope: Skills, training and ability to participate in IAM.
concerns.inclusion: Explicit training, skills or learning requirements.
concerns.exclusion: Verbosity, knowledge of the scenario or generic safety.
concerns.illustrative_anchors: Rejects training altogether=1; willing with accessible training=5; supports skills programmes=8.

concerns.label: Perceived safety and privacy
concerns.scope: Experienced safety concern and personal privacy/surveillance boundaries.
concerns.inclusion: Personal surveillance, camera intrusion, fear of injury or perceived risk.
concerns.exclusion: Camera intrusion is not automatically a technical security defect or aesthetic objection.
concerns.illustrative_anchors: Strong surveillance boundary with conditional openness=2; cautious safety acceptance=6; clear personal comfort=8.

concerns.label: Technical safety, security and privacy
concerns.scope: System reliability, safety engineering, data governance and cybersecurity.
concerns.inclusion: Explicit failure mechanisms, data retention/access, hacking or technical safeguards.
concerns.exclusion: Personal discomfort with being viewed, without technical/data claims.
concerns.illustrative_anchors: Rejects systems even with safeguards=1; requires verified controls=3–5; endorses stated controls=7–8.

concerns.label: Noise
concerns.scope: Acoustic disruption, operating hours and sound tolerance.
concerns.inclusion: Explicit sound, hum, rest disruption or audibility conditions.
concerns.illustrative_anchors: Strong acoustic objection, willing if inaudible or rerouted=3; moderate reservation=4–5; qualified acoustic acceptance=7.

concerns.label: Visual pollution
concerns.scope: Aesthetic sky clutter and visible physical intrusion.
concerns.inclusion: Explicit aesthetic/clutter objection or separate objection to visible low aircraft.
concerns.exclusion: Seeing cameras watch property alone is privacy. Altitude alone does not prove aesthetic objection.
concerns.illustrative_anchors: Conditional low tolerance for explicit visible intrusion=4; no visual acceptance position=null; clear aesthetic acceptance=8.

concerns.label: Wind and downwash/outwash
concerns.scope: Rotor wind/downwash effects and placement safety.
concerns.inclusion: Explicit gusts, rotor wash, outwash or wind-related placement.
concerns.exclusion: Noise or ordinary wind weather without rotor effects.
concerns.illustrative_anchors: Strong impact boundary with mitigation openness=3; accepts protective placement=7.

concerns.label: Airspace capacity
concerns.scope: Traffic density, airspace allocation and capacity.
concerns.inclusion: Explicit airspace crowding, traffic separation or capacity allocation.
concerns.exclusion: Flight frequency as a noise/visual cause alone.
concerns.illustrative_anchors: Conditional airspace objection pending separation=3–5; supports allocation plan=8.

concerns.label: IAM integration into SUMPs
concerns.scope: Integration into a sustainable urban mobility plan.
concerns.inclusion: Explicit city mobility strategy, governance integration or SUMP.
concerns.exclusion: Mention of city or routing alone.
concerns.illustrative_anchors: Conditional planning acceptance pending consultation=5; supports mobility-plan integration=8.

concerns.label: Infrastructure and land use
concerns.scope: Physical facilities, siting and allocation of land.
concerns.inclusion: Explicit pads, vertiports, construction, zoning or allocation of land.
concerns.exclusion: Request to move a flight path off homes without land/facility planning.
concerns.illustrative_anchors: Siting objection open to alternate site=4; supports suitable planned facilities=8.

concerns.label: Energy demand and emissions
concerns.scope: Energy demand, lifecycle emissions and environmental trade-offs.
concerns.inclusion: Explicit electricity, energy use, carbon or emissions.
concerns.exclusion: Electric hum alone or vague responsible language.
concerns.illustrative_anchors: Conditional acceptance pending net environmental benefit=5; supports specified benefit=8.

concerns.label: Cost, ROI and business models
concerns.scope: Costs, financing, return and business viability.
concerns.inclusion: Explicit taxes, funding, operating cost, affordability of business or returns.
concerns.exclusion: A flight delay alone; public service support alone.
concerns.illustrative_anchors: Conditional support pending affordable funding=5; endorses a viable funding model=8.

concerns.label: Accessibility for remote areas and vulnerable groups
concerns.scope: Access for remote areas, disability and vulnerable groups.
concerns.inclusion: Explicit geographic or vulnerability access barriers/benefits.
concerns.exclusion: Saving lives alone does not establish accessibility or fair distribution.
concerns.illustrative_anchors: Concern about exclusion with conditional support=3–5; supports targeted access=8.

concerns.label: Multimodality and congestion
concerns.scope: Connections with other transport and congestion.
concerns.inclusion: Explicit links to buses, roads, ambulances or relieving congestion.
concerns.exclusion: Generic route relocation or medical speed alone.
concerns.illustrative_anchors: Conditional acceptance pending integration=5; supports transport connections=8.

concerns.label: Welfare and equity
concerns.scope: Public welfare benefits and separately distributive equity.
concerns.inclusion: Explicit lifesaving medical public-service endorsement (FN facet) OR distribution/fairness claims.
concerns.exclusion: Benefit support does not imply equity knowledge or fair access; count this concern once.
concerns.illustrative_anchors: Clear lifesaving public-service support=8 even with local opposition; explicit equity reservation can lower combined concern readiness; categorical rejection of welfare goals=1.
